x86-seses-only-lfence-non-const.help: Only lfence before groups of terminators where at least one branch instruction has an input to the addressing mode that is a register other than %rip.
x86-seses-only-lfence-non-const.name: x86-seses-only-lfence-non-const

x86-setjmp-csr-warning-threshold.help: Basic block count threshold for emitting a warning about callee-saved registers reserved due to setjmp
x86-setjmp-csr-warning-threshold.name: x86-setjmp-csr-warning-threshold

x86-sfb-inspection-limit.help: X86: Number of instructions backward to inspect for store forwarding blocks.
x86-sfb-inspection-limit.name: x86-sfb-inspection-limit

x86-slh-fence-call-and-ret.help: Use a full speculation fence to harden both call and ret edges rather than a lighter weight mitigation.
x86-slh-fence-call-and-ret.name: x86-slh-fence-call-and-ret

x86-slh-indirect.help: Harden indirect calls and jumps against using speculatively stored attacker controlled addresses. This is designed to mitigate Spectre v1.2 style attacks.
x86-slh-indirect.name: x86-slh-indirect

x86-slh-ip.help: Harden interprocedurally by passing our state in and out of functions in the high bits of the stack pointer.
x86-slh-ip.name: x86-slh-ip

x86-slh-lfence.help: Use LFENCE along each conditional edge to harden against speculative loads rather than conditional movs and poisoned pointers.
x86-slh-lfence.name: x86-slh-lfence

x86-slh-loads.help: Sanitize loads from memory. When disable, no significant security is provided.
x86-slh-loads.name: x86-slh-loads

x86-slh-post-load.help: Harden the value loaded *after* it is loaded by flushing the loaded bits to 1. This is hard to do in general but can be done easily for GPRs.
x86-slh-post-load.name: x86-slh-post-load

x86-sse2avx.help: Specify that the assembler should encode SSE instructions with VEX prefix
x86-sse2avx.name: x86-sse2avx

x86-tile-ra.help: Enable the tile register allocation pass
x86-tile-ra.name: x86-tile-ra

x86-use-base-pointer.help: Enable use of a base pointer for complex stack frames
x86-use-base-pointer.name: x86-use-base-pointer

x86-use-fsrm-for-memcpy.help: Use fast short rep mov in memcpy lowering
x86-use-fsrm-for-memcpy.name: x86-use-fsrm-for-memcpy

x86-use-vzeroupper.help: Minimize AVX to SSE transition penalty
x86-use-vzeroupper.name: x86-use-vzeroupper

x86-widen-shift.help: Replace narrow shifts with wider shifts.
x86-widen-shift.name: x86-widen-shift

x86-wineh-unwindv2-force-mode.help: Overwrites the Unwind v2 mode for testing purposes.
x86-wineh-unwindv2-force-mode.name: x86-wineh-unwindv2-force-mode

x86-wineh-unwindv2-instruction-count-thr.help: Maximum number of (approximate) instructions before splitting into a new unwind info.
x86-wineh-unwindv2-instruction-count-thr.name: x86-wineh-unwindv2-instruction-count-threshold

x86-wineh-unwindv2-unwind-codes-threshol.help: Maximum number of unwind codes before splitting into a new unwind info.
x86-wineh-unwindv2-unwind-codes-threshol.name: x86-wineh-unwindv2-unwind-codes-threshold

x86-wineh-unwindv3-instr-avg-size.help: Average size of an instruction. This value is used in determining split points for chained unwinder info
x86-wineh-unwindv3-instr-avg-size.name: x86-wineh-unwindv3-instr-avg-size

x86postlegalizercombiner-disable-rule.help: Disable one or more combiner rules temporarily in the X86PostLegalizerCombiner pass
x86postlegalizercombiner-disable-rule.name: x86postlegalizercombiner-disable-rule

x86postlegalizercombiner-only-enable-rul.help: Disable all rules in the X86PostLegalizerCombiner pass then re-enable the specified ones
x86postlegalizercombiner-only-enable-rul.name: x86postlegalizercombiner-only-enable-rule

x86prelegalizercombiner-disable-rule.help: Disable one or more combiner rules temporarily in the X86PreLegalizerCombiner pass
x86prelegalizercombiner-disable-rule.name: x86prelegalizercombiner-disable-rule

x86prelegalizercombiner-only-enable-rule.help: Disable all rules in the X86PreLegalizerCombiner pass then re-enable the specified ones
x86prelegalizercombiner-only-enable-rule.name: x86prelegalizercombiner-only-enable-rule
